name: Astronomy
description: Astronomy word search puzzles gather star and sky English for adults and seniors — nebula, orbit, telescope, eclipse, constellation and calm night-sky words — without planetarium brands or app slogans. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays curious and unhurried: galaxy, comet, aurora, horizon, chart and eyepiece vocabulary many lifelong sky-watchers already know. This hub pairs well with Space and Weather when you want a longer looking session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as quiet as a clear winter night.
